posts.title: 5 rules for a long life

slides.headline:
5 rules for a
*long life.*
slides.body: Easy habits, years of cooking. Swipe.

slides.headline:
Preheat
*1 to 2 minutes.*
slides.body: Low-to-medium flame is all it needs.

slides.headline:
Let it cool,
*then wash.*
slides.body: A soft sponge, never steel wool.

slides.headline:
A few drops,
*no spray.*
slides.body: Skip aerosol cooking sprays on the coating.

slides.headline:
Dry it,
*hang it.*
slides.body: Dry fully and hang it by the loop on the handle.

posts.caption:
Save this one for later.

1. Preheat 1 to 2 minutes on low-to-medium flame.
2. Wooden or silicone spatula only.
3. Let it cool, then wash with a soft sponge.
4. A few drops of oil, no aerosol spray.
5. Dry fully and hang it by the loop.

Simple habits keep your Tawaana cooking for years. tawaana.com
